sites.evidence_type: published tag insertion in the same loop or domain
sites.functional_impact_measured: NOT MEASURED — the paper (PMC12629418) uses Flag-GS-DDR2 as a construct but does not report a dedicated functional or surface-expression assay for the tagged protein relative to untagged DDR2.
sites.rationale: L5 states the Flag insertion is 'three amino acids after the predicted signal peptide cleavage site.' The signal peptide spans residues 1–21 (authoritative landmark); the mature protein begins at residue 22 (K). Three residues into the mature protein are K22, A23, Q24; the tag therefore sits between Q24 and V25, giving insert_after_residue = 24. Python confirms seq[23]='Q' and seq[24]='V'. The site is 376 residues from the TM boundary (400), deep in the large extracellular domain, and is an internal extracellular position. L4 confirms the same construct was built on full-length WT DDR2. Full-length DDR2 construct (Flag-GS-DDR2) generated by QuickChange mutagenesis on WT DDR2 template; Flag tag with GSGSGS linker inserted three amino acids after the predicted signal peptide cleavage site (SP = residues 1–21, mature protein begins at residue 22; three residues in = after residue 24, before V25), placing the tag in the extracellular N-terminal region of the membrane-anchored receptor. Expressed in mammalian cells.

sources.claim: The insertion site of the Flag tag was located three amino acids after the predicted signal peptide cleavage site.

literature_notes: L1, L2, and L3 all describe C-terminal myc-tagged DDR2 constructs. L2 pins the tag to E855 (full-length WT and K608E) and G517 (ΔKD truncation). Residue 855 falls in the intracellular domain (421–855) and residue 517 is likewise intracellular; both are recorded in other_positions. The ΔKD isoform is also a truncation, not a full-length receptor, so it does not qualify as a surface-tag site regardless. No ledger line supports any other extracellular insertion in DDR2.

literature_other_positions.note: Myc tag fused to the C-terminal residue E855 of full-length DDR2 WT and K608E; residue 855 is intracellular (domain 421–855), confirmed by topology landmarks.
Myc tag fused to G517 in the ΔKD (kinase-domain truncation) isoform; residue 517 is intracellular (domain 421–855) and the construct is a truncation, not a full-length receptor.
